subject: Re: Request for DPF evidence and cross-border transfer mapping — Sunrise Health
messages:
From: Amir Singh <amir.singh@sunrisehealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Ellen Park <ellen.park@sunrisehealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Sunrise RFI — DPF evidence and transfer mapping

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for taking this. As part of our procurement/assurance review we need a concise package demonstrating Redwood's approach to cross-border data transfers and DPF controls. Specifically we need:  
- A mapping of where personal data may be processed (US regions, any EU/APAC pass-through).
- Evidence that the transfer mechanism meets DPF requirements (SCCs, contracts, supplementary measures).
- Operational controls (encryption in transit/at rest, KMS, key residency options, logging/audit trails).
- Recent SOC 2 report and an outline of retention/erasure workflows for EU data subjects.

Can you provide these materials and a short cover note we can share with Legal & Privacy? We are on a tight timeline — asking for an initial package by EOD Tue 2027-04-12.

Best,
Amir
Director, Product Security
Sunrise Health
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Amir Singh <amir.singh@sunrisehealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-10T10:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sunrise RFI — DPF evidence and transfer mapping

Amir —

Thanks, we can assemble that. Quick clarifications so we scope correctly:  
1) Do you need an export showing per-customer region binding (i.e., customers pinned to EU-only physical hosts) or a general product-level mapping?
2) For the DPF evidence, do you prefer our legal redlines + SCC implementation notes, or a vendor attestation summary for procurement?

I'll gather SOC 2 and the DPF mapping and loop in our legal ops for the contractual pieces. If you confirm the preference on (1) and (2) I’ll aim for the EOD Tue target.

Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Hannah —

I ran the tenant mapping. Sunrise Health is currently configured for US-west (primary) with EU-fallback disabled in their account. That means live inference traffic for their workspace is processed in US regions. We do have a private deployment option (VPC/on-prem) and an EU-region pinning feature for Dedicated customers — I included the feature note below for the cover letter.

I attached a CSV export to my internal note (will include as attachment in the package): tenant-region-mapping.csv (fields: tenant_id, primary_region, allowed_fallbacks, datacenter_ips).

Monica
Engineering Program Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-12T09:55:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Sunrise RFI — DPF evidence and transfer mapping

Hannah / Monica —

Attaching: SCC-implementation-notes.xlsx and SOC2-report-2026.pdf (redacted). Summary below for the cover note: 

- Contractual basis: Redwood implements EU SCCs (2021 standard clauses) with downstream subprocessor flow-down. Our DPA Annex includes a DPF mapping table and responsibilities.
- Supplementary measures: TLS1.3 in transit, AES-256 at rest, per-customer KMS support (Bring Your Own Key for Dedicated/Private), IP allowlists for management plane, and mandatory data minimization for telemetry.
- Technical measures for equivalence: geo-fencing of KV-caches, per-request region tags to avoid cross-region cache promotion, and proof-of-concept logs demonstrating no EU user PII exported outside EU regions for EU-pinned customers.
- Retention/deletion: Subject access and deletion workflows are handled via our support portal with audit logs; deletion triggers a secure wipe of caches and key revocation where applicable.

I'll send the packaged attachments once Hannah finalizes the cover note.

-Markus
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Amir Singh <amir.singh@sunrisehealth.com>, Ellen Park <ellen.park@sunrisehealth.com>

Date: 2027-04-14T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request for DPF evidence and cross-border transfer mapping — Sunrise Health

Amir / Ellen —

Please find our initial evidence package attached and summarized below. We focused on the items you listed; if Legal wants further redlines or a live walkthrough we can schedule one this week.

Package contents (attachments):
- redwood-dpf-mapping-2027.pdf — high-level mapping of processing locations, per-product flow, and where transient caching may occur. Notes: Sunrise Health tenant is currently hosted in US-west; EU residency can be achieved via Dedicated EU-hosting or Private deployment.
- scc-implementation-notes.xlsx — our implementation summary for SCCs, subprocessor flow-down, and the supplementary technical and organizational measures we apply.
- soc2-report-2026.pdf — SOC 2 Type II report (redacted).

Key excerpts (for quick review):
- Transfer mechanism: Redwood executes the 2021 EU SCCs as part of our DPA; for customers that require DPF equivalence, we combine SCCs with contractual commitments, encryption-in-use where applicable, and regional hosting options.
- Supplementary measures: TLS 1.3, AES-256 at rest, per-customer KMS (BYOK available for Dedicated & Private), immutable audit logs with 90-day search retention (longer retention available as an add-on), and role-based access controls with MFA for all ops staff.
- Practical mitigation for mixed routing: If a customer requires no cross-border export, we offer EU-only Dedicated pools or an on-prem package. For hosted accounts, we provide a migration playbook and can schedule a canary migration to EU nodes.
- Evidence artifacts: sample tenancy routing logs, SCC template included in the XLSX, and the SOC 2 report.

Related links: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/sunrise-dpf-evidence-2027 (full folder), HS-CRM-87291.

Next steps: let us know if Legal wants the unredacted SOC 2 or a countersigned DPA annex; we can also set up a short verification call with Markus.

Regards,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-dpf-mapping-2027.pdf (application/pdf), scc-implementation-notes.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet), soc2-report-2026.pdf (application/pdf)
